name: WF-437 — Seller Offer Presentation, Objection Handling & Negotiation Follow-Up Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const offerId=String(b.offerId??'').trim(); const eventType=String(b.eventType??b.outcome??'').trim().toLowerCase(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,dealId,offerId,eventType,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Seller Offer Event').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const blocked=['dnc','suppressed','closed','cancelled','disputed']; const state=String(ctx.dealState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); const flags=[]; if(blocked.includes(state)||ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true)flags.push('deal_or_contact_blocked'); const event=input.eventType; const valid=['offer_presented','seller_question','objection','counteroffer','accepted','rejected','no_response','callback_requested','dnc']; if(!valid.includes(event))flags.push('unknown_event'); const objectionText=String(input.objection??input.message??ctx.latestSellerMessage??'').toLowerCase(); const objectionTypes=[]; if(/price|too low|offer/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('price'); if(/repair|condition|work|fix/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('property_condition'); if(/time|think|later|not ready/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('timing'); if(/fee|commission|cost/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('fees_or_costs'); if(/family|partner|spouse|discuss/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('decision_maker'); if(/cash|financ|fund/.test(objectionText))objectionTypes.push('funding'); let negotiationState='manual_review',nextAction='review_seller_offer_event',followUp=null;if(flags.length){negotiationState='blocked';nextAction='stop_negotiation_follow_up';}else if(event==='accepted'){negotiationState='accepted';nextAction='advance_to_contract_readiness';}else if(event==='counteroffer'){negotiationState='counteroffer_received';nextAction='evaluate_counteroffer_against_protected_mao';}else if(event==='rejected'){negotiationState='rejected';nextAction='reengage_or_nurture';}else if(event==='dnc'){negotiationState='dnc';nextAction='stop_all_contact';}else if(event==='no_response'){negotiationState='awaiting_response';nextAction='schedule_negotiation_follow_up';followUp={cadenceMinutes:[240,1440,4320],maxAttempts:3};}else if(event==='callback_requested'){negotiationState='callback_requested';nextAction='schedule_callback';}else if(event==='objection'||event==='seller_question'){negotiationState='objection_handling';nextAction='prepare_objection_response_and_follow_up';followUp={objectionTypes,requiresHumanReview:objectionTypes.includes('decision_maker')||objectionTypes.includes('funding')};}else if(event==='offer_presented'){negotiationState='offer_presented';nextAction='monitor_seller_response';followUp={cadenceMinutes:[240,1440],maxAttempts:2};} const offer=Number(ctx.offerAmount??input.offerAmount??0); const protectedMao=Number(ctx.protectedMao??0); const safeOffer=offer>0&&(protectedMao<=0||offer<=protectedMao); if(!safeOffer&&!['accepted','rejected','dnc'].includes(event))flags.push('offer_economics_require_review'); const idempotencyKey='wf437:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.offerId+':'+input.eventType; return [{json:{...input,sellerOfferDecision:{status:flags.length?'review_required':'evaluated',negotiationState,nextAction,objectionTypes,followUp,offerAmount:offer,protectedMaoCheck:safeOffer?'within_protected_limit':'requires_economic_review',flags,requiresHumanReview:negotiationState==='manual_review'||(followUp?.requiresHumanReview===true),confidenceScore:flags.length?35:(negotiationState==='manual_review'?55:94)},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, dealId, offerId and eventType are required'} }}

meta.notes: Seller offer presentation and objection handling is scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM offer/negotiation schema, communication provider, seller-response classification, protected-MAO source of truth, and production API contracts.
